content.answer: Reject values where isinstance(v, bool) before checking isinstance(v, int): valid exit codes are integers in [0, 255] with type(v) is int (or not isinstance(v, bool)), so True/False are not accepted.
content.reuse_advice: In any validator that accepts int, check `isinstance(value, bool)` first and reject it, since bool subclasses int in Python; use `type(value) is int` or an explicit bool guard to prevent True/False silently passing as 1/0.
